headline: Wall Street Cuts Bitcoin Miner Targets on Texas Political Shift
summary: Wall Street lowered price targets for bitcoin miners following a Democratic win in Texas, which raised concerns over potential delays to artificial intelligence data center projects.
why: Bitcoin miners operate large-scale data infrastructure that is increasingly utilized or repurposed for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads.

impacts.name: Bitcoin Mining
impacts.why: Lowered price targets and political regulatory concerns negatively affect the sector outlook.
